name: Han, Oni Storm Strider

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Spiked chain
items.description: Eladrin duelists are thought to be the first to employ this weapon, and its combination of speed and elegance supports that theory. The spiked chain delivers raking blows from a distance. Like a whip or a flail, it can also wrap around a foe’s legs to send that enemy tumbling to the ground.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Binding Chains
traits.details: Whenever Han teleports, he can teleport with him any creature he is grabbing. The teleported creature appears in a square adjacent to the square Han teleported to.

hit.description: lightning and thunder damage. Han can grab the target if he does not already have two creatures grabbed (escape DC 25). Whether or not Han grabs the target, he can pull it up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to him.
thunder damage, and the oni pushes the target up to 2 squares. If the attack hits a creature the oni has grabbed, the creature also takes 2d10 extra lightning damage, and the grab ends.

effect.description: Before or after the attack, the oni teleports up to its speed.
The oni teleports up to 3 squares.

The oni disguises itself to appear as a Medium or Large humanoid until it uses deceptive veil again or until it drops to 0 hit points. Other creatures can make a DC 39 Insight check to discern that the form is an illusion.
